Position Overview As a General Manager at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing retail and culinary teams that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. This position combines strategic business acumen with strong operational expertise to drive both culinary and retail business performance while delivering #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. Workweeks are expected to be between 46 and 48 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. 3+ years of retail management experience, preferably in a specialty or culinary retail environment. Current Food Manager Certification, or ability to acquire certification as needed Proven track record of achieving sales and motivating high performing sales teams while meeting operational goals. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain a high performing team. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. review_candidates.description: Responsibilities Oversee and enforce preventive and corrective maintenance schedules across all fleet vehicles to ensure reliability, safety, and cost efficiency. Ensure accurate root-cause diagnosis of technical issues and oversee effective, first-time-right repairs to minimize downtime, avoid repeat failures, and control maintenance costs across the OpCo fleet. Provide continuous technical guidance to fleet supervisors to support sound decision-making, focusing on cost-effective repair strategies, proper vendor selection, and optimal maintenance approaches. Support the registration, evaluation, and periodic assessment of workshops, service providers, and spare parts vendors to ensure quality, competitiveness, and compliance with ABC standards. Monitor and control maintenance spend by challenging unnecessary repairs or replacements, promoting repair vs. replace decisions based on lifecycle cost analysis and solid technical justification. Conduct regular technical audits, inspections, and spot checks to verify quality of repairs, ensure accurate diagnosis, and confirm adherence to maintenance standards across all OpCo. Ensure with random audits that all vehicles comply with Heineken’s technical, safety, and mechanical integrity standards, with timely corrective actions for any identified deviations. Ensure fleet supervisors maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date service history, repair records, and technical documentation in Maximo to support tracking and transparency, data-driven decisions, and audit readiness. Develop, implement, and continuously improve maintenance SOPs to standardize practices, reduce variability, and strengthen technical governance across all operations. Deliver technical training and coaching to fleet supervisors to enhance troubleshooting skills, improve diagnosis accuracy, and strengthen cost awareness. Participate in accident investigations by providing technical assessments, identifying root causes, and recommending preventive actions. Support the technical evaluation, inspection, and compliance checks during vehicle onboarding and offboarding processes. Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, preferably Automotive. 2+ years of experience in fleet maintenance or after sales service. Strong knowledge of vehicle systems, diagnostics, and maintenance planning. Familiarity with telematics and fleet management platforms. Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Recruit real estate developers, investment managers and project owners to participate in the Real Estate Exhibition. Develop relationships with organisations seeking direct access to private capital and institutional investors. Secure commercial participation through sponsorships, exhibition packages, memberships and strategic partnerships. Identify appropriate senior executives for speaking and thought-leadership opportunities. Develop long-term commercial relationships with participating organisations beyond individual summits. Build relationships with UK organisations seeking expansion into Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman. Identify opportunities involving capital raising, investment, joint ventures, strategic partnerships and market entry.
